name: Human
description: Ubiquitous and diverse throughout the galaxy, humans can find a place in nearly every Alliance role.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 56

abilities.name: Starting skills
abilities.summary: Choose one rank in two different non-career skills; neither skill may exceed rank 2 during character creation.

name: Bothan
description: Data collectors and skilled manipulators, Bothans are natural fits for intelligence and diplomacy.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 51

abilities.name: Streetwise
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in Streetwise; it may not exceed rank 2 during character creation.

abilities.name: Convincing Demeanor
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in the Convincing Demeanor talent.

name: Droid
description: Droids fill vital Alliance gaps across technical, medical, astrogation, and support roles.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, pp. 52–53

abilities.name: Machine needs
abilities.summary: Droids do not need to eat, sleep, or breathe and are unaffected by toxins and poisons.

abilities.name: Cybernetics
abilities.summary: The cybernetic implant cap is 6 instead of the droid's Brawn rating.

abilities.name: Additional training
abilities.summary: After choosing a career, train one rank in six career skills; after choosing a specialization, train one rank in three specialization skills.

abilities.name: Inorganic
abilities.summary: Bacta, stimpacks, and Medicine checks do not restore droid damage; rest, Mechanics checks, and repair patches are used instead. Begin with one rank in Enduring.

abilities.name: Mechanical Being
abilities.summary: Droids cannot become Force-sensitive, gain a Force rating, use Force powers, or be affected by mind-altering Force powers.

abilities.name: Integrated equipment
abilities.summary: With GM approval, equipment can be intrinsic to a droid's construction or installed as an upgrade.

name: Duros
description: Revered pilots, explorers, storytellers, engineers, and mechanics, Duros bring hard-won knowledge to the Alliance.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 54

abilities.name: Piloting (Space)
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in Piloting (Space); it may not exceed rank 2 during character creation.

name: Gran
description: Keen-sighted, peaceful, and community-minded, Gran are often drawn to service and support roles.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 55

abilities.name: Starting skill
abilities.summary: Choose one rank in Charm or Negotiation; the chosen skill may not exceed rank 2 during character creation.

abilities.name: Enhanced Vision
abilities.summary: On ranged combat or Perception checks, remove up to two setback dice imposed by environmental conditions or concealment, but not defense.

name: Ithorian
description: Ithorians are devoted caretakers of natural environments whose pacifism shapes their service to the Rebellion.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 57

abilities.name: Survival
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in Survival; it may not exceed rank 2 during character creation.

abilities.name: Ithorian Bellow
abilities.summary: Natural weapon: Resilience; Damage 6; Critical 4; Short range; Blast 3, Concussive 1, Slow-Firing 2, Stun Damage. Using it costs 3 strain.

name: Mon Calamari
description: Artisans, dreamers, and committed allies, Mon Calamari combine compassion with strategic and technical gifts.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, pp. 58–59

abilities.name: Knowledge (Education)
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in Knowledge (Education); it may not exceed rank 2 during character creation.

abilities.name: Amphibious
abilities.summary: Breathe underwater without penalty and never suffer movement penalties for traveling through water.

name: Sullustan
description: Affable, curious, and free-spirited, Sullustans often carry their natural direction sense into the stars.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 60

abilities.name: Astrogation
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in Astrogation; it may not exceed rank 2 during character creation.

abilities.name: Skilled Jockey
abilities.summary: Begin with one rank in the Skilled Jockey talent.
